description: ADR 0012 addendum (2026-11-22): rule themes. A signal gets a rule theme when a row of seed/theme-rules.csv matches it: match 'source' compares the signal's source (signalsource choice label), match 'feed' compares the key of the signal's feed (crdr_feed.crdr_key), both exactly. The first matching row wins. No match gives no rule theme (null): the assessment's LLM theme is kept. A rule theme takes precedence over the LLM theme and is written whatever theme the signal already has. A rule whose theme is not in seed/themes.csv is a configuration error, never applied. Written before the engine (CLAUDE.md).

cases.note: rule wins over an existing theme
rule wins over the LLM theme
release notes have no rule: the LLM theme stays
blog posts have no rule: themed by the assessment
feed keys compare exactly, as Dataverse stores them
the feed rule needs only the feed key

configErrors.note: unknown theme: refused at load, never applied

natureNote: ADR 0013 section 4 (step 5): a model retirement with automatic migration is a behaviour change; without one, breaking. seed/theme-rules.csv's optional nature column carries it per feed; a rule nature takes precedence over the LLM's, and an empty nature leaves the LLM's. A nature not in the schema's nature choice is a configuration error.

natureCases.note: prompts move to the tier's replacement automatically
Microsoft Copilot harness: replaced by the replacement model
standard harness: only the GPT Chat Latest alias and managed solutions move automatically
a theme rule with no nature: the LLM's (none for incidents) stays
